paper_title: Probing MeV to 90 GeV axion-like particles with LEP and LHC
notes: New LEP exclusion on ALP two-photon coupling derived by the authors from LEP Z-pole data on BR(Z->2gamma) (dashed, low-mass reach via collimated photon pair) and BR(Z->3gamma) (solid, high-mass) branching-ratio measurements [refs 41,43-47]. Curve is the LOWER ENVELOPE (weakest excluded coupling) of the green LEP excluded region in Fig 4(b) (file gagacouplingfull.pdf), the panel for a coupling ONLY to photons (production via virtual photon), which is directly in the canonical variable g_agamma per Eq (1.1): L = -(1/4) g_agamma a F Ftilde -- identical to task-card AxionPhoton normalisation, no conversion. The excluded region is open-topped (clipped at g=1); reported curve is its lower boundary. Fig 4(a) (BBcouplingfull.pdf) is an alternative scenario with coupling to hypercharge bosons g_aBB (stronger, on-shell Z production) but plotted in a different native variable, so not used. Vector coordinates recovered via pymupdf get_drawings; axes calibrated from tick labels: log10 m = (x-283.3)/16.35, log10 g = -(y-16.4)/384.6*12. Mass range ~1 MeV to ~m_Z (91 GeV; polygon extends slightly past to ~112 GeV at the tapered right tip). Confidence level assumed 0.95 (LEP BR limits); paper does not state CL explicitly for the derived bound. FCC-ee/LHC curves in the figure are projections and excluded.
